id.description: A short kebab-case name for the task, unique within the job's tasks.

outcome.description: What the person gets done, one sentence in the business's words, naming no control, page or medium.

actor.description: Who does it: a role of the business, or 'person' when nothing says more.

actions.description: Every legacy entry point the task is made of; each belongs to exactly one task.

rules.description: The ids of the business rules decided by those entry points.

facts.description: The ids of the kinds of data the task reads or changes.

needs.description: The ids of the outside systems the task reaches.

intent.description: What the person is trying to get done in this step, in the words of the business.

system.description: What the system does in response.

from.description: The legacy entry points that make up this step.

confidence.description: sure when the code states it, inferred when it was concluded from the code.

items.description: One step of how a task is done today.

current.description: How the task is done today, in order, each step citing its entry points.

items.description: A task people do with the system: an outcome, not a screen.
